title: Category Six
description: Simulate a network of 50 Intcode computers exchanging packets, with a NAT device detecting idle states.
writeup:
## Approach

Boot 50 Intcode computers, each initialized with its network address (0-49). Run them in round-robin, feeding packets from input queues or -1 when empty, and routing output triples (dest, X, Y) to the appropriate queue.

## Part 1

Simulate the network until any computer sends a packet to address 255. The answer is the Y value of that first packet.

## Part 2

A NAT device captures packets sent to address 255. When the entire network is idle (all queues empty and no computer produced output in a full round), the NAT sends its last received packet to computer 0. The answer is the first Y value the NAT delivers to address 0 twice in a row.
